messages:
Ava (Sales): Heads-up — FinCorp EU signed LOI and wants POC next week. Requirements: EU data residency, DPA redlines, AML attestation, and DocuSign routing for MSA+order form. Can legal/proc confirm routing and any non-starters?
Sam (Solutions Eng): For the POC we'll provision Dedicated in eu-west-1 with VPC peering. Need their CIDR and expected QPS by Friday to size.
Priya (Security): They added a security questionnaire excerpt asking about key rotation, SOC2, and BYOK. I can draft answers but need clarity on KMS options (customer-managed keys?).
Noah (Legal): Please attach their redlines. High-level: we generally push back on unlimited indemnity and perpetual liability; propose a capped approach. Also we need to see exact DPA edits before approving.
Lauren (Procurement): DocuSign routing note: billing contact + PO number required before final signature. Payment terms — do they accept Net30? Customer requested Net45. Also need their VAT registration for EU invoicing.
Ava (Sales): They want Net45 for year 1. Can we make an exception for < $200k ARR? If not, I'll escalate. Also sending redline PDF now.
Noah (Legal): We can agree to Net45 for renewals or with a credit check; for signature-ready MSA prefer Net30 initially. If they insist on Net45 now, escalate to VP Sales.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick POC config to share with customer:
```yaml
# POC config
deployment:
  mode: dedicated
  region: eu-west-1
  vpc_peering: true
  nodes: 2
model: redwood-2-7b
kv_cache: enabled
```
Priya (Security): Note: Hosted offering cannot support BYOK; customer-owned CMKs are available on Private deployments only. I'll prepare the SOC2/Security questionnaire answers with that caveat.
Lauren (Procurement): I'll request their PO template and VAT form. Who is billing contact on the customer side? Send to procurement@redwood.com.
Ava (Sales): @Lauren (Procurement) billing contact is marie.dupont@fincorp.eu. Sending calendar invite for sync Mon 10:00 CET.
Noah (Legal): Reviewing redlines now. If changes are limited to DPA + payment terms we'll likely get to sign-off today/tomorrow. If they edit SLA/indemnity, it'll take longer.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Also confirm SLA ask — they want 99th percentile latency guarantee for inference. We should map that to Dedicated SLA and call out fallback model variants.
Ava (Sales): Thanks. Quick checklist for tomorrow's sync: 1) Confirm billing + VAT, 2) Agree on payment terms or escalation path, 3) Finalize DPA redlines, 4) POC infra checklist, 5) Signature routing in DocuSign.
deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_672388) — routing planned: Ava -> Lauren -> Noah -> Customer.
Ava (Sales): Appreciate the quick turn. I'll post the redline PDF and the customer's PO template in this thread. :crossed_fingers:
